{{Top|leg}}
'''Imperial Naval Communiqué 31756''' was a coded transmission that was sent by [[Ysanne Isard]], the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]], circa [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was sent to senior [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial naval]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] and contained an intercepted [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] transmission that had been sent by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], one of the Alliance's leaders, calling for Alliance forces to rally in three [[City/Legends|cities]]: [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] and [[Keren/Legends|Keren]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. In the message, Isard also stated that Imperial [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] were to be [[Invasion of Bestine|assigned]] [[Invasion of Dearic|to]] [[Invasion of Keren|capture]] each of the three locations, and that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] had taken a personal interest in the matter.
